description: Calibration sample: Left 4 Dead 2 re-authored under docs/audit/rag-eval-query-style.md. Terse controller input, proper nouns where the game shows them, three skill levels, versus coverage. Not scored — this exists for the maintainer to check the feel before the other 10 titles are rewritten. Several power_user rows deliberately target content the corpus does not have yet (versus, tier lists, map callouts); they stay in so the gap shows up as a miss rather than being hidden by only asking what we can answer.

queries.intent: Survive the heavy special: kite, focused fire, avoid cornering
queries.note: Name is known — characters shout it. Withholding 'Tank' would be unrealistic.

queries.intent: Avoid vs crown decision, and what startles her
Kill at range; bile pulls the horde
Spacing and formation against the ram special
Line-of-sight breaking and teammate rescue

queries.query: my team keeps wiping on the bridge at the end of the parish, what are we doing wrong
queries.intent: Finale pacing on that campaign
queries.note: Voice register — longer and more sentence-like on purpose. Campaign named, chapter not.

queries.intent: Tier list across melee options
queries.note: Maintainer example. Needs a ranking card shape the corpus does not have.

queries.query: what rooms usually have good loot in dead center burning building
queries.intent: Item spawn locations in a named chapter
queries.topic_hint: Dead Center — hotel/burning building item spawns
queries.note: Maintainer example. Chapter-level detail; corpus is campaign-level today.

queries.query: expert friendly fire keeps killing us
queries.intent: Formation and fire discipline at the top difficulty

queries.query: hard rain best time to move
queries.intent: Routing around the storm cycle
Health item economy going into the last stand

queries.query: death charge spots on the roof of no mercy
queries.intent: Map-specific instant-kill charger positions, playing infected
queries.note: Maintainer example. Versus content and a map-callout card shape; corpus has neither.

queries.query: dark carn best infected coordination spots
queries.intent: Where an infected team should stack an ambush on that campaign
queries.note: Maintainer example. Note the abbreviation — 'dark carn' is how it gets typed.

queries.intent: Leading the throw as the tank player

queries.query: hunter pounce spots for full damage
queries.intent: Height requirement and map positions for a max-damage pounce

queries.query: rush or slow for versus points
queries.intent: How distance scoring rewards pace
Playing as the special, not fighting it — positioning, when to pull, how to survive after
queries.note: Near-identical wording to S-L4D2-05 but the opposite perspective. Retrieval has to tell 'smoker grabbing me off roofs' from 'how to use smoker' — the discriminating word is 'use'. If one card serves both, it is the wrong card.

queries.intent: When to pick the jockey over other specials, and what it is good at
queries.note: 'ride' and 'steer' were withheld and should not have been: they are the ordinary words a player uses for what a jockey does, like 'tank' for the tank. Withholding shared vocabulary makes the query unrealistic. Only distinctive card phrasing belongs here.

queries.intent: Whether that spawn order is a good coordinated push
queries.note: Maintainer example. Three proper nouns and one question mark — no verb at all. Retrieval has to read this as 'is this ordering good' rather than as three separate lookups.

queries.intent: Where the acid actually denies ground

queries.query: when to spawn as tank vs save it
queries.intent: Tank timing as the infected team
Suicide timing and horde placement as the boomer
queries.note: Pairs with S-L4D2-03 the same way 18 pairs with 05 — same special, opposite side.

queries.query: where to spawn infected without getting shot
queries.intent: Ghost-mode positioning: spawn out of sight and in range of the survivors' path
queries.note: The first thing a versus player has to learn and the corpus has nothing on it.

queries.query: how to break a jockey ride
queries.intent: Survivor-side counter: shoot it off, and what happens if you shove instead
queries.note: Pairs with S-L4D2-19. Same special, opposite side; two different cards or the split is wrong. 'ride' and 'steer' were withheld and should not have been: they are the ordinary words a player uses for what a jockey does, like 'tank' for the tank. Withholding shared vocabulary makes the query unrealistic. Only distinctive card phrasing belongs here.

queries.intent: Playing the charger: approach line that takes one survivor away rather than bouncing the group
Steering a ride into hazards, drops, or away from the team
Whether the witch can be turned into a weapon by the infected team, and how
queries.note: Third sense of 'witch' after S-L4D2-02. Avoid, crown, or exploit are three different answers.

queries.intent: Survivor response when specials attack in a coordinated order
queries.note: Survivor-side mirror of S-L4D2-20. The sample had counters to single specials but none to a coordinated push.

queries.intent: Unanswerable as written — depends entirely on campaign and chapter
queries.note: The class the gold-spider question exposed. Right behaviour is a follow-up question, not a wall of cards. Whether retrieval or the model handles that is undecided.
